Further, It is adv ised to study the HTC MTF and PRICE BID Carefully as various clauses has been amended/ modified or new ly inserted and the METHODOLOGY of quoting rate on GeM portal has been revised. All Prospective Bidder s are requested to go through MTF Clause 8 “Submission of Tender”, Sub-Clause s (e), (f), (g) and (h) for q uoting one uniform percentage of rate with respect to the schedule of rates as per Appendix VII (Price Bid). No separate rates shall be quoted for Handling works. MTF Clause 8 “Submission of Tender”, Sub-Clauses ( 4 / 6 e), (f), (g) and (h) are as follows:- (e) Price Bid has to be quoted at the requisite place in the GeM Port al.(f) The tenderer shall quote one uniform percentage of rate with respect to the schedule of rates as per Appendix VII (Price Bid). No separate rates shall be quoted for Handling and Transportation works. (g) The bidders/ tenders shall quote the rates on the GeM portal in the below prescribed manner only: Schedule of rates (SOR) - The bidder cannot quote negative value as per GeM format. The Schedule of Rate value is eq uivalent to 100% and accordingly, the BSOR can be between 0 to 100 % and the ASOR will be above 100% . Illustration – If the Schedule of Rates (SoR) as mentioned in the bid is Rs. 100, then the percent rate quot ed by the bidder on the GeM portal will be treated as under: I. If the bidder quotes 100% then the rate will

be treated as Rs. 100 X 100% i.e. Rs. 100 which is equivalent to Schedule of Rates (SoR). i.e. at par with S oR. II . If the bidder quotes 60% then the rate will be treated as Rs. 100 X 60% i.e. Rs. 60 which is Below Sc hedule of Rates (BSoR). i.e. 40% BSoR. III. If the bidder quotes 120% then the rate will be treated a s Rs. 1 00 X 120% i.e. Rs. 120 which is Above Schedule of Rates (ASoR). i.e. 20% ASoR. (h) Tender which do not c omply with these instructions shall be summarily rejected. NOTE: GeM has formulated General Terms & Co nditions (GTC) in their portal. As per the provision of GeM, the Terms & Conditions stipulated in Additional Terms & Conditions (ATC) and Service Level Agreement (SLA) will supersede those in GTC in case of any c onflicting provisions. In case of any conflicting clause(s) between GeM and FCI's MTF, the clause( s) of FCI'S MTF will prevail. .
